system: Wild & Wandering PMS & Channel Manager Engine

principles.zero_shims: NEVER write fuzzy regex shims or name aliases. If a function name changes, refactor the caller, never write a fallback wrapper.
principles.immutable_room_ids: Private rooms are raw user strings. Dorm beds are strictly '[Dorm Name] № [01..NN]'. No code may add 'C' prefixes or strip '0' prefixes.
principles.occupancy_law: ONLY ['here', 'future', 'new', 'special' (with assigned room)] occupy live space. ['cancelled', 'noshow', 'unconfirmed', 'charged', 'tocharge', 'vol'] NEVER occupy space.
principles.channex_freeze: channex.js is certified under strict rate limits (<= 18 ARI calls/min) and 2-call 500-day sync. Its implementation is read-only and frozen.
principles.parser_strategy: Manual clipboard parsing is owned exclusively by parser/. Each OTA has an isolated adapter. Automated Channex webhooks go directly to Cloud Functions.

prohibited: Direct String.split('-') in UI components without parseYMD
Hardcoded status arrays in calendar or inventory loops
Mutating room IDs e.g. adding 'C' or zero-padding single-digit privates
Raw unrounded floating-point calculations in financial views

exports: customAlert(title: string, message: string, isConfirm?: boolean, onConfirm?: Function): void
showToast(title: string, msg: string, type?: 'success'|'error'): void
prohibited: Calling native window.alert or window.confirm in production UI

exports: getNetAvailabilityForDate(cat: string, date: string, cap: number): number
extractBookingData(rawText: string): { s: object, summary: string }
prohibited: Direct DOM input reads inside individual OTA adapters
